question: What should be drawn and inscribed outside the previous structure in this ritual diagram?
premises: Eight petals should be made outside that area.
Writing is to be done on those petals.
Eight syllables of the mātṛkā should be written there.
inference: One should draw eight petals outside and write eight mātṛkā syllables on them.
plain_english: Outside that, having made eight petals, one should write eight syllables of the mātṛkā on the petals.
